title: Diptimoyee Mondal vs Salem Gomango on 6 March, 2026

paragraphs.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF ORISSA AT CUTTACK
 MATA No.212 of 2025

 Diptimoyee Mondal

 .... Appellant
 Represented by Adv.-
 Mr. Hemanta Mohanta, Advocate
 on behalf of Mr. Soubhagya Kumar Dash


 -versus-
 Salem Gomango .... Respondent

 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANASH RANJAN PATHAK
 AND
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MURAHARI SRI RAMAN

 ORDER

02. 1. Heard Mr. Hemanta Mohanta, learned counsel on
 behalf of Mr. Soubhagya Kumar Dash, learned counsel for
 the appellant.

2. The appellant, as a petitioner, earlier filed a petition
 under Section 10(1)(ix) of the Indian Divorce Act before the
 Court of learned Judge, Family Court, Parlakhemundi, being
 Civil Proceeding No.08 of 2025, seeking a decree of
 dissolution of her marriage with the respondent-husband.
 The learned Judge, Family Court, Parlakhemundi, by
 judgment dated 08.05.2025, dismissed the said Civil

 Page 1 of 2
 Proceeding No.08 of 2025 preferred by the appellant-wife.
 Hence, this appeal.

3. In the meanwhile, during pendency of the appeal, the
 respondent-husband expired on 20.02.2026.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant files a memo in
 Court today seeking withdrawal of this appeal. The said
 memo is taken on record.

5. Accordingly, this appeal, being infructuous on the
 death of the respondent-husband, stands dismissed as
 withdrawn.

(Manash Ranjan Pathak)
 Judge


 (Murahari Sri Raman)
 Judge
